description: This file defines an interface IVersionManager which manages grain interface version negotiation strategies, including setting compatibility and selector strategies globally and for specific interface types.

classes.name: IVersionManager
classes.description: Interface for managing grain interface version compatibility and selection strategies.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the global compatibility strategy for grain interfaces.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the global selector strategy for grain interfaces.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for a specific interface type.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the selector strategy for a specific interface type.
